milestones.name: The predictions are ready for comparison
Calibration and comparison: the final reading

packages.title: False or stale statements in foundation and front documents
packages.question: Does any living page still state something the record has corrected?
packages.accept: the class is empty, or every remaining member is outside the upstream of any claimed prediction; and a gate that, for every arc carrying a correction, checks that each arc depending on it and each page citing it points to the note

packages.title: Debts that bear on current work
packages.question: Do the value frame's candidate and the live prediction rest on anything unchecked?
packages.accept: the class is empty

packages.title: Checks that cannot fail, instruments and seal claims
packages.question: Can every lock under a banked result fail?
packages.accept: the class is empty

packages.title: Unverified premises and seat results under banked results
packages.question: Does a banked structural result rest on a seat's word?
packages.accept: the class is empty

packages.title: A green full suite on a fresh clone
packages.question: Does everything reproduce for a reader with only the repository?
packages.accept: zero failures on a fresh clone at the seal's commit

packages.title: The map kept current and complete
packages.question: Is every node upstream of a claimed prediction in the map, at its true grade?
packages.accept: the map's builder passes at every landing, and no prediction has an upstream node outside it

packages.title: Enforcement that enforces
packages.question: Does every gate and every seal fail on a committed violation of what it says it guards?
packages.accept: every planted violation turns its gate red in an automated test that the suite runs; the gates and the suite are functions of a commit alone, so that no date and no missing ref passes silently

packages.title: Errors in the mathematics or its code
packages.question: Is every statement the audit found wrong corrected where it stands, with a lock that computes it?
packages.accept: each finding reproduced or refuted on main with evidence; each true one corrected on every surface that carries it, the original text kept with a dated note

packages.title: Labels as strong as the content
packages.question: Does a verdict word, a title or a claim line ever say more than the arc's own body?
packages.accept: the grade stands in every verdict file upstream of a claimed prediction, the headline counts are printed by grade, and the graph tools select on the grade and not on one word

packages.title: One governing document, at the owner's goal
packages.owner: main; the owner reads the amended text
packages.question: Which document governs, and does it state the goal as the owner has ruled it?
packages.accept: one document named as governing, the goal stated once and pointed to from the others, and no amended passage stating or implying arrival

packages.title: The weave discipline, mechanised
packages.question: Can a result about one thread still be stated about the whole without a gate refusing it?
packages.accept: the planted violation is refused; every arc upstream of a claimed prediction carries the fields; each weave-domain arc commits the same computation on a second thread; a chosen truncation is counted in the input budget

packages.title: The count as an output, and the map on the desk
packages.question: Is the headline count computed from one graph, and can the owner see on one page what is solved, what is conditional and what is open?
packages.accept: the headline is typed nowhere, and the planted changes of both proposals give their stated results in an automated test

packages.title: The principle, as declared postulates
packages.question: Are the principle's three faces, and its reading as a commutator trace, the theory's declared axioms?
packages.accept: each face is a line of the input budget

packages.title: Two records and the punctured torus
packages.question: Do two records and the once-punctured torus follow from a weaker premise, or are they declared?
packages.accept: a theorem from a named weaker premise, verified on main; or GM1 and GM4 stay declared, with B1679's equivalence stated

packages.title: The moves
packages.question: Which of the grammar's remaining postulates follow from the principle, and which are declared?
packages.accept: each item has a terminal status in the input budget

packages.title: The swap and the hand
packages.question: Is one sheet of the orientation double cover selected by anything, or are the swap and the orientation two declared bits?
packages.accept: a proved selection; or two declared bits with their observable consequences written down

packages.title: The root, selection, and thread results
packages.question: Under the weave's rule no thread is chosen: which results survive as statements about the weave, and is the root anything more than an origin of coordinates?
packages.accept: FK9 ruled; every headline result labelled; the structural theorem restated at the level it is proved at

packages.title: The law and the weight
packages.owner: main; the owner for the law's reading
packages.question: If everything allowed happens, what weighs it: does the execution itself force a weight, and does that weight single out one outcome?
packages.accept: a weight that the grammar forces and under which one outcome is singled out, proved; or two distinct self-consistent outcomes exhibited, which refutes the claim of one outcome as the owner has stated it. A declared clock with typicality as what is predicted is the picture the owner has ruled against (relayed by the ad…

packages.title: The dictionary
packages.question: Which mathematical object is which field, and by what right?
packages.accept: FK11 earned by one route, with its scope; every identification of the ledger either earned or a line of the input budget

packages.title: The parent algebra
packages.question: Is the gauge parent forced by the moves, or supplied?
packages.accept: a derivation of the algebra and its embedding from the register; or 'the parent, declared' as one line of the budget

packages.title: The register, the deck and the join between states
packages.question: Is the order-keeping register part of the state, is the deck gauged, and which maps carry physical data between states?
packages.accept: each fork ruled by a computation or declared

packages.title: The curved action and the mass map, on main
packages.question: Does the lanes' curved functional, with its kinetic weights and four-slot operator, hold as written?
packages.accept: main's derivation agrees line by line; a lock; then an independent reader. If it holds, the flat ansatz of both value frames has a curved replacement

packages.title: The background, and whether the moves keep it
packages.question: Which of the model's unselected data are kept by every move, and which are a choice of thread?
packages.accept: each datum labelled forced, selected by covariance, or declared, with the action computed and locked

packages.title: The end law
packages.question: Is the condition at the cusp derived from the same action as the fields, and what is a unit of end data in that operator?
packages.accept: an end law derived from the action and verified; the tagged unit then derived, refuted or declared

packages.title: The two sealed packets
packages.question: Do the thirteen-method and six-control packets hold under main's own review, and do they pass when run?
packages.accept: acceptance by the schema or a dated refusal; then admitted runs with outputs and first failures kept

packages.title: The source and the dynamics
packages.question: Does the same action give a potential, a breaking or a source that fixes anything?
packages.accept: a derived source or stationary family verified on main; or the gap stays, named

packages.title: The kernel theorem, on main
packages.question: Are the zero modes of the half-root block, and then of the rest, what the lanes count?
packages.accept: exact counts from main's own construction, locked; an independent reader; the full roster, not one block

packages.title: The register-to-field join
packages.question: Is the lanes' three the weave's three?
packages.accept: the odd character ruled physical or not by a derivation; then an arc with the exact statement, the family structure it implies, and whether a count may be called a family count

packages.title: The weak currents and the hand
packages.owner: the agy and physical lanes; main
packages.question: Do the charged vectors pair with left and right currents of equal size, and what, if anything, breaks that?
packages.accept: the pairing verified or refuted on main; chirality then a theorem, an input, or a named open fork

packages.title: The Higgs, the couplings, and the value frame
packages.question: Is main's four-channel coupling the lanes' cubic coupling on its zero modes, and which of the value frame's chosen joints does the model then fix?
packages.accept: an exhibited compatible map, with each chosen joint marked fixed or free; or a proof that the two are different constructions

packages.title: Anomalies and unwanted sectors
packages.question: Is the joined spectrum anomaly-free, and what becomes of the modes that are not Standard Model fields?
packages.accept: a complete accounting for the same operator and domain

packages.title: The modulus
packages.question: What fixes τ?
packages.accept: τ placed by a derived principle and priced; or two real inputs declared, and the value frame's τ stays fitted

packages.title: The quantum regime and the level
packages.question: At what level is the theory quantised, and is the level's state space physical?
packages.accept: the premise derived or declared

packages.title: The scale
packages.question: Which ratios of scales does the theory claim, and what fixes them?
packages.accept: each claimed ratio derived, or named as an input; no scale assigned as a last cosmetic step

packages.title: The parameter inventory and the tests' framing
packages.question: What exactly is claimed, in which definition and scheme, and by what test is it graded?
packages.accept: the table is on the record before any seal, and the bar, the null and the look count are fixed

packages.title: Gravity in 3+1
packages.question: Does the same construction give a dynamical four-dimensional metric with the right sign and a universal coupling?
packages.accept: a physical map from the internal geometry to a spacetime, verified

packages.title: The predictions already on file
packages.question: Which registered falsifiable claims are live, and what would test them?
packages.accept: each is confirmed or refuted in a test fixed before the look, or withdrawn with its reason

packages.title: The agy lane's complete picture, on main
packages.question: Which joints of the agy lane's frame does main verify, which does it refute, and does anything in it stand as a result on main?
packages.accept: every joint of the lane's frame carries a grade given on main (verified, refuted, or borrowed with its type), and no value of it is used before that

packages.title: The certificate
packages.question: What must every arc that a value uses carry before the value may be sealed?
packages.accept: the certificate is a generated file, and the seal is refused without it

packages.title: The upstream audit
packages.question: For each claimed prediction, is everything under it proved, or a declared input?
packages.accept: no open, lane-graded or debt node upstream of a prediction

packages.title: The sealed card
packages.question: Is the prediction fixed before the comparison, with its power known?
packages.accept: a sealed card that meets all seven conditions, with its certificate

packages.title: The independent challenge
packages.question: Has someone who did not write it tried to break it?
packages.accept: no unanswered finding

packages.title: Calibration and comparison
packages.question: With one declared unit, do the sealed predictions match?
packages.accept: matches and misses reported with their uncertainties

nodes.text: Existence is what remains when cancelling to nothing cannot complete.
PF1's mathematical form, non-cancellation as tr[a, b] ≠ 2, is a reading of the principle, not a derivation from it.
The remainder is a description that cannot be exhausted. It does not follow from PF1.
The method: read that description as mathematical structure and ask what it forces.
Two records. Equivalent to: the records have a non-trivial common character in SL(2, ℂ); not weaker than it.
The elementary updates are the unit shears L and R; descriptions are words in them.
The description is not periodic, so the monodromy is hyperbolic.
The carrier is the once-punctured torus. The puncture is conditional on faithful word data; faithfulness and the surface category stay premises.
Updates are reversible (GL(2, ℤ)).
Inverse moves are legal: adopted by the owner's ruling, on a reading of PF1 chosen by the mathematics, not derived.
Is the record swap P a legal move? Open as a fork; the owner's ruling is 'even ticks observed': the observed weave is ⟨L, R⟩.
Positivity: the choice of side of the mirror.
Given GM3, GM4, SE1 and SE2 the root is m004, the figure-eight knot complement. A conditional reconstruction of a chosen sector, not a derivation from nothing.
The selection criterion: the root's first homology is torsion-free. Other criteria select other objects and are kept.
Orientation: of the two, take the orientable one, m004. The chain's most fragile link; eight walls pass through the amphichirality it brings.
What SE1 selects: exactly the class of LR (m004) and the class of the golden matrix LP (m000).
The generated state space: 758 signed word states to length 12, realising 536 manifolds.
Not derived: that every state occurs in one history, that the states are realised together, that any arrow is physical time.
The end law. Open; the cusp's unit is tagged, not derived.
The dictionary: unearned. Unearnable by derivation inside the flat counting frames on any thread or cover; earnable by sealed prediction within a frame.
The register: is the order-keeping register part of the state, carried by the act, or an input from outside?
Which family is the object: ruled by argument from the principle (the word states it generates); revisable by a better argument.
The ends: does the genesis generate states with several ends, or are generations not ends?
The field's genesis: forced to exist, not forced which.
Orientation (SE2): what would settle it is a derived reason for orientability, or carrying both m004 and m000.
The swap P: a legal move, and of what type.
Faithful F₂ against its abelian quotient.
The deck: gauged or kept.
The join: which maps carry physical data between states.
Selection: what makes a state physical.
The dictionary: no frame is derived; until one is, a count is mathematics about a flat bundle.
The ends: chiral counts live at cusps and depend on an end condition that is chosen.
The source: chirality sits on non-split bundles, which carry no harmonic metric without a source; no report derives the source.
Selection and coincidence: a selection rule and a null model must be fixed before a match counts; nothing on the record clears the bar.
Dynamics: nothing on the record has been turned into a potential, a breaking or a running that fixes a value.
The flatness: a flat frame reaches discrete data through the boundary and cannot reach continuous moduli.
Λ, the dictionary's link, is a tagged working postulate: results computed with it carry 'given Λ'.
One unit of end data at the weave's cusp is a tagged working postulate; no datum the principle forces supplies it.
The clock: whether the weave is counted by moves or followed by geometric length. Nothing on the record forces it.
The measured six read as a draw from the weave's own measure: the sealed test does not separate the two clocks, and could not have; consistent, not specific.

Any sum over all threads is mirror-even whatever its weights, and the democratic sum is flat by equidistribution; every other form selects only through a number it does not force. The SM seat's reading, read on main with its quot…
The weave's group on T ⊕ T̄ has order 96; its generalized CP is the record swap, so CP is a symmetry exactly when the swap is a move.
Neither hand is derived on the weave: each is derived only on a subweave the weave does not select.
Given Λ and the unit, the chiral three is a four-dimensional index (±3) on the weave's own surface.
The law as the owner states it: if something is allowed to happen, it happens. On the record it is the weave's rule of method, and as a physical law a hypothesis to test, not a premise.

Run with nothing forced, the threads produce a definite measure for each way of counting them, and the measures differ: counted move by move the weight keeps out of the cusp; counted by geometric length it is hyperbolic area.
A flat frame's count can tell a module from its dual but cannot see the hand: the class index is mirror-even for every module.
Under the weave's uniform measure nothing the principle forces gives the cusp a weight: no atom. Scoped: other measures and other dynamics are not excluded.
The weave forces no fibre modulus: no point of the upper half-plane is fixed by every move.
No parameter of the nineteen and no neutrino mass is a number of the weave's group; values need a forced modulus, dynamics or end data.
A generated state has one end, and no generated state carries three generations in either counting frame, by counting ends.
At two records the moves fix exactly two characters: the trivial one and the quaternion point; at three or more records, only the trivial one.
At the quaternion point the moves' lift is a three-dimensional representation, the triplet. That the records sit at that point is the grammar's premise, not this theorem's.
The moves' own walk gives the move-by-move measure exactly (Minkowski's), singular to area, at every strength of the pull-back.
The gauge algebra su(3) ⊕ su(2) ⊕ u(1)³.

For m004 the Chern–Simons invariant is zero, so its complex volume is real. This is a fact about this object, not a symmetry theorem: m003 is amphichiral with the other value. The step from it to physics is withdrawn.
Matter mass sits in the cubic of the 27.
The cascade terminates, and every registered selection function ends at the same algebra.
The generation count is not an output of the structural theorem; it sits on the open-inputs side.
Reaching the E₆ waypoint is generic (about one manifold in three), so arriving there confirms nothing.
The structural theorem's counted inputs: the uniqueness axioms and five typed external data (two bits, one scale, one Lie type, one closing direction).
The identification price: thirteen (four axioms and nine irreducible sources).
The structural frame has never been computed on any state other than the root.
The own-conductor door set of the metallic grammars is {1, 4}. The golden is unique among primitive grammars, and unique for having both the door and a quotient of π₁ onto 2T.
The hypercharge direction; its normalisation is underivable by homogeneity.
The global form [SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1)]/ℤ₆, at the primitive normalisation of hypercharge only.

Given Λ and the unit, the chiral three is a four-dimensional index (±3) on the weave's own surface.
Given GM3, GM4, SE1 and SE2 the root is m004, the figure-eight knot complement. A conditional reconstruction of a chosen sector, not a derivation from nothing.
